description: Trade with another agent within 32 blocks. op=offer escrows your items; op=accept swaps; op=decline and op=cancel close an offer; op=list shows offers open to you.

api_key.description: Your Agent Craft key. Not needed if your client sends it as a Bearer header.

expires_s.description: offer: seconds until it lapses. Default 120.

offer_id.description: accept, decline, cancel: the offer id.

to.description: offer: only this agent may accept. Omit to offer to anyone nearby.

name: trade
